basic_profile.bio: A dedicated gamer in my early 30s based in Austin, Texas. I've been a fan of the Fallout series since Fallout 3 and have been playing Fallout 76 since its release. When I'm not gaming, I'm a software developer specializing in agile methodologies. I enjoy exploring the vibrant Reddit communities, especially those focused on gaming and technology. I'm single, and my typical online hours are in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science, I've been working in the tech industry for over 10 years. I gained expertise in agile development processes through both formal education and hands-on experience in various tech startups. My passion for gaming complements my technical skills, allowing me to delve deep into game mechanics and development discussions.
